svg.text: In the scarce scenario most investigations end in a human escalation. When resources are genuinely insufficient that is the intended outcome: an exhausted budget does not enter a

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: retry loop, it produces an evidenced human case.
